name: v2.2.5
body:
## What's Changed

### New Features 🎉

* feat: expose new cache options and enable cache store in rebuild by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15690

### Performance 🚀

* perf(loader): use one-shot refs for js values by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15636

### Bug Fixes 🐞

* fix: inline runtime chunks with empty names by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15685
* fix: align inline loader module types with webpack by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15684
* fix(rslib): render externalized new URL targets as plain relative URLs by @elecmonkey in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15670
* fix(rstest): resolve manual mocks next to package entries by @9aoy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15689
* fix: avoid chunk name collisions in compact hashed ids by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15693

### Refactor 🔨

* refactor(core): share BuildContext across module graph tasks by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15674

### Other Changes

* chore: migrate maintenance scripts to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15675
* chore: release version 2.2.5 by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15702

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/compare/v2.2.4...v2.2.5
